canonical_project: 41-45 Barton Street Katoomba data centre proposal
owner: Council Approval Group / Thurlow Group Australia
notes: Blue Mountains City Council welcomed withdrawal of the development application for a data centre at 41 Barton Street, Katoomba. DCD reported the original proposal as a 3,118 sqm facility at 41-45 Barton Street with three generator buildings and AUD 4.8m estimated cost; community reporting described it as a 1-2 MW industrial data centre. Capacity recorded as midpoint because official capacity was not published in trade coverage.
